plugin.note: Cave bugs have 5 hitpoints and a max hit of 1. Any weapon kills them; a light source is mandatory in the Lumbridge Swamp Caves. They have a 50% weakness to fire spells for anyone training Magic.

requirements: 7 Slayer is required for cave bug assignments.
A light source (oil lantern, bullseye lantern, or similar) is required in the Lumbridge Swamp Caves.
Enter the caves by tying a rope to the hole east of Lumbridge Swamp.
mechanics: Cave bugs have only 5 hitpoints and a max hit of 1.
They attack with melee (stab/crush) and are not a threat.
They have a 50% weakness to fire spells.

methods.label: Melee
methods.summary: Kill cave bugs with any melee weapon; they have 5 HP and a max hit of 1, so gear is irrelevant to survival.
steps: Tie a rope to the swamp hole and descend with a lit light source.
Attack cave bugs with any melee weapon until the task is complete.

methods.label: Fire spells
methods.summary: Cast fire spells for the 50% elemental weakness while training Magic in the caves.
requiredOrKeyItems: Fire spell runes or a fire-based staff
steps: Cast Fire Strike/Bolt/Blast for the 50% fire weakness.
Keep a light source equipped or in your inventory at all times.
